spec.description: Downward parabola through origin with positive turning abscissa.
spec.mathematics: Gradient decreases through zero at the maximum.

answer.worked: The parabola's gradient decreases steadily from positive to negative, becoming zero at its maximum to the right of the y-axis. This gives line (C).

spec.description: Descending-end cubic through origin with two turning points.

answer.worked: The gradient is negative before the minimum, positive between the turning points and negative after the maximum. Option (I) has two zeros and this sign pattern.

spec.description: Positive bell-shaped curve with maximum on y-axis and flattening tails.
spec.mathematics: Positive gradient left, zero at maximum, negative right.

answer.worked: The curve rises to its maximum at the y-axis, then falls. Its slopes tend to zero at both tails, matching the positive-left and negative-right graph (B).
